html:
Navneel Dancing in his Class

How beautiful were those days when we has the liberty to do what we wish at the cost of little scolding. The liberty to ask questions and not bother about answering any. The portion of life where we were god’s creation.

Then a time came where we had to pay price for asking questions and we became answerable to each and every individual around us. Now we can do what we wish only in free time which is almost extinct. This is the portion of life, where we are society’s creation.

Namaste!!!

– Stray Dog
